description: This file defines Room database entities for recipes and their associated notes, including data classes for Recipe, Note, and a composite class RecipeWithNotes.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Entity representing a recipe with fields for id, title, category, instructions, image resource, and favorite status.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity representing a note linked to a recipe, with fields for id, recipeId, and content.

classes.name: RecipeWithNotes
classes.description: Data class combining a Recipe object with its associated list of notes.
